content.title: Breakfast Kart Race | Pace Escalation, Finish Line and Group Celebration
content.summary: Bakery mascots prepare a teapot kart, witness one lap and celebrate its finish. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One original vehicle, driver and support group retain stable designs. + The start group, circuit and finish stripe belong to one continuous venue. + Departure follows visible readiness checks rather than an unexplained jump. + The finish is proven by the complete vehicle crossing the marked threshold. + The terminal celebration reunites the original group and stopped vehicle.
quick_start.recommended_input: Gather five original bakery mascots around a teapot-shaped kart beneath the exact banner "SUNRISE LAP". Launch the teapot kart into one left-to-right side track around a red-white bakery circuit. Return the five mascots around the stopped teapot kart; release bread-shaped confetti and hold the shared cheer.
required_anchors: One original vehicle, driver and support group retain stable designs.
The start group, circuit and finish stripe belong to one continuous venue.
The finish is proven by the complete vehicle crossing the marked threshold.
The terminal celebration reunites the original group and stopped vehicle.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用一组原创食物角色和一辆杯形小车建立起点检修，载具沿同一赛道连续加速、过弯并穿越明确终点；终点后回到原伙伴群体，以彩屑和手势验证抵达。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One original vehicle, driver and support group retain stable designs.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One original vehicle, driver and support group retain stable designs."

invariants.rule: The start group, circuit and finish stripe belong to one continuous venue.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The start group, circuit and finish stripe belong to one continuous venue."

invariants.rule: Departure follows visible readiness checks rather than an unexplained jump.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Departure follows visible readiness checks rather than an unexplained jump."

invariants.rule: The finish is proven by the complete vehicle crossing the marked threshold.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The finish is proven by the complete vehicle crossing the marked threshold."

invariants.rule: The terminal celebration reunites the original group and stopped vehicle.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal celebration reunites the original group and stopped vehicle."
